correctness.rationale: A cyclic walk in the restricted six-edge de Bruijn graph has uniquely constrained flow p(s,a,b), with n=2s+a+b. Marking any occurrence of vertex 01 yields a bijection with two independently chosen s-position detour subsets. Double counting marks proves exact fiber size n/s binom(s,a)binom(s,b) for every n>=2 including zero detour boundary. Product balancing at fixed s is strict for |a-b|>=2, and checking exactly all feasible s gives the global maximum. Direct complete word enumeration independently verified n=2..18.

value.rationale: The maximum list size for full cyclic k-mer observations is a natural worst-case reconstruction ambiguity and determines the exact best possible no-error list-size guarantee. This theorem computes it at every block length by O(n) binomial comparisons, identifies all profile types and shows why balanced detours are extremal; counting only the number of achievable profiles cannot supply this bound.
